div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 558px; height: 1px; padding-top: 17px; margin-left: 12px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #222222;
display: inline-block; font-size: 16px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#222222, #d0d0d0); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span:
Read top to bottom. Every solid arrow is a request, answered back on the same path.
One trace id (traceparent) runs from the adapter through the service and NGINX to the relay.
